meta.retrieval_note: BKA PKS 2025 county values are read from a public visualization mirror because the BKA download endpoint resets automated GitHub-runner connections. The mirror explicitly cites the BKA Kreistabellen; Berlin values are cross-checked against Polizei Berlin PKS 2025.
meta.dark_figure_note: PKS contains police-recorded crime; unreported offences are not included.
